quest.title: The Clueless Goblin
quest.description: Goblins, while vile and hostile on the best of days, rarely perpetrated such successful slaughter. On the other hand, they did tend to squeal like stuck pigs under the correct motivations...

node.journal_entry: ...and indeed, squeal it did! True to form, rather than enter a meaningful discourse and provide valuable information, the Goblin Warlord decided to go down the "disembowel the longshanks" approach! I am curious, now, in retrospect, did you actually think the vile little bag of putrid hostility would actually speak to you?

By bloody moonlight written, by bloodless moonlight revealed. Bring the Acolytes flesh to the appointed place within the capital. The saturation of the vessel is at hand! For he is dark and born of terror...

...and indeed, squeal it must have! But not, as it turns out, by your hand. Twas another's blade that did the deed, but the Goblin Warlord's corpse had clues enough to yield. Well, ok it had one, but my rhyme was fairly good no? A single letter written in pagan form:

In the heart of Carpendale bathed in blood and sweat, a salamander, a brownie, and a kobold met, a pyramid they made in the blackest night, where inside there was a Greenroot cave, awash in the moon's bright light.

In the heart of Idawoll bathed in blood and sweat, a troll, a salamander, and another troll met, a pyramid they made in the blackest night, where inside there was a volcano, awash in the moon's bright light.

In the heart of the Moon Plains bathed in blood and sweat, a salamander, a Sarnakh and another Salamander met, a pyramid they made in the blackest night, where inside there was a secluded grotto, awash in the moon's bright light.

In the heart of Firun bathed in blood and sweat, a salamander, a troll, and another troll met, a pyramid they made in the blackest night, where inside there was a caveclad trollish bust, awash in the moon's bright light.
